**Research methods:**

- Look at BBB (Better Business Bureau) ratings
- Ask for recommendations in local Pleasanton Facebook groups
- Get quotes from 3-5 companies to compare prices and services

**What to look for:**
- Licensed and insured (verify with CA Public Utilities Commission)
- Positive customer reviews
- Transparent pricing (no hidden fees)

- Good communication

- Local independent movers (often more personalized)
- Larger regional companies (more resources)
